note: The one list of the runner's verbs and options. host.gd's OPTIONS table must equal it (a selftest case checks that); the Foreman reads it instead of keeping a copy.
modes_note: N2. World modes of the host (kernel/world/). They are not verify verbs: no tl.verify/1 report, no --pack, no level; they print tl.world/1 lines. host.gd's MODE_OPTIONS table must equal this list (the same selftest case). tools/world.sh is the wrapper.

frames.note: ticks of each pack's own clock; one value or one per pack

at.note: x:y:z per pack: where the pack stands in the world

spacing.note: pack i stands at (i * spacing, 0, 0) when --at is not given

every.note: the pack gets one world tick in N

pause.note: <pack index|all>:<from world tick>:<ticks>, several separated by ;

mode.note: smoke (nobody plays) or bot (each pack's first test plays it)

space.note: own (one physics space per pack) or shared (the default space; a measurement control)

trace.note: record a state hash every N pack ticks

hold.note: world ticks to keep running after every pack has finished (all switched off)

state.note: include each pack's _pack_state in its line

out.note: also write the lines to this file

walk.note: N5a. a walk script (tl.walk/1): plots, the player's scripted positions, tickets; the scheduler (kernel/world/tiers.gd) decides who ticks; replaces --packs

replay.note: N5a. a world log (tl.worldlog/1) written by --log: the same walk, the logged decisions instead of new ones

log.note: N5a. write the world log of a walk to this file

tiers.note: N5a. the thresholds of the scheduler

cost.note: N5a. model (a pack tick costs what tiers.json says) or measured (the world's clock)

ticks.note: N5a. world ticks of a walk

world.note: N5a. load a world file (tl.world/1); replaces --packs; --frames defaults to 0 then

save.note: N5a. write the world file when the run ends (temporary file, read back, rename; rev counted up)

name.note: N5a. the world's name in a saved file

seed.note: N5a. the world's own seed, kept in the world file

plot-spacing.note: N5a. with --packs: plot i lies at (i * spacing, 0, 0) in the world; the pack is still simulated at its own origin (unlike --spacing and --at, which move the simulation)

scenery.note: N7: plot is the default for worlds. full, or plot: a pack's layout is built without its far terrain and scattered forest (the landscape around a plot is the world's); 70 to 90 % of a seed's loading time, no body of the simulation

only.note: run only the tests whose name contains this

world-view.note: N7. Needs a window (not --headless). tools/view.sh and tools/world.sh tour start it.

packs.note: comma-separated pack directories (pictures of a world of packs; tools/view.sh shot)

at.note: x:y:z per pack: the PLOT of each pack (the packs are simulated at their own origin)

stage.note: with --packs: the pack drawn at zero offset, with its cameras and HUD

scenery.note: plot (default) or full, as for the world mode

walk.note: N7. a walk script (tl.walk/1) with visitor = true: the scheduled world in a window, its visitor, landscape and tour pictures (tools/world.sh tour); replaces --packs

log.note: N7. with --walk: write the world log

out-dir.note: N7. with --walk: where the numbered pictures of the walk's shot events go

live.note: N7. with --walk: a person walks (WASD, E to enter, Q or Esc to leave); the walk script only places the plots

landscape.note: N7. with --walk: on (default) or off: the road, the scatter, the plot edges and the mesas
